# PURISTA LLM Context

PURISTA is a TypeScript framework for message-driven backend systems.

## Published context files
- Public root context: `/llms/llms.txt`
- Public deep context: `/llms/llms-full.txt`
- Public sandbox context: `/llms/sandbox.txt`
- Public sandbox deep context: `/llms/sandbox-full.txt`

## Canonical docs
- Handbook index: https://github.com/puristajs/purista/blob/master/web/src/content/handbook/index.md
- Agent handbook: https://github.com/puristajs/purista/blob/master/web/src/content/handbook/2_building_business-logic/ai/index.md
- Ecosystem docs: https://github.com/puristajs/purista/blob/master/web/src/content/handbook/3_eco_system/index.md

## Markdown for agents
- Handbook markdown entry point: /handbook.md
- Handbook page markdown pattern: /handbook/<path>.md
- API reference markdown entry point: /handbook/api.md
- API reference page markdown pattern: /handbook/api/<kind>/<slug>.md
- AI Harness markdown entry point: /harness.md
- AI Harness page markdown pattern: /harness/<path>.md

## Machine-readable preflight

Before changing an existing application, export definitions and run:

```bash
purista inspect --definitions purista.definitions.json --format json
purista validate --definitions purista.definitions.json --strict --format json
```

Both commands are static-only: they do not contact live bridges, stores,
scheduler providers, or model providers. Their JSON output omits handler
functions, credentials, prompts, transcripts, and provider instances.
